title: MAPPA Produces 'Beat & Motion' Anime Adaptation for 2027
content:
The 15th Anniversary Event of MAPPA announced an anime adaptation of Naoki Fujita 's Beat & Motion manga on Friday, revealing main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video. The anime will stream exclusively worldwide on Netflix in 2027.

Voice actors Shuuichirou Umeda ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) and Aya Gomazuru ( Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi ) aree starring as Tatsuhiko Hirayama and Nico Kashiwagi, respectively.

Staff Director: Yuki Komada ( Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Kyoto Douran )

• Assistant Director: Izumi Takizawa ( Yofukashi no Uta Season 2 )

Series Composition, Script: Misaki Morie ( Zenryoku Usagi (2023) ) Character Design: Kazunori Aoki ( Dororo chief animation director) Chief Animation Director: Mina Osawa ( Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii? ), Kazunari Aoki Chief Episode Director: Megumi Soga ( Koi wa Sekai Seifuku no Ato de episode director) Art Director: Haruna Sakamoto ( Alice to Therese no Maboroshi Koujou background art)

• Color Design: Minori Nishida ( Vinland Saga Season 2 )

CGI Producer: Yuusuke Tannawa ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) 3DCG Directors: Sayaka Tsushima, Tamaki Ishida ( Lazarus 3DCG modelling) Director of Photography: Madoka Yagi ( Dance Dance Danseur ) Editing: Masato Yoshitake ( Kowloon Generic Romance ) Script Supervision, Concept Design: Tomoyuki Itamura ( Yofukashi no Uta director) Stylist: Mari Ishibashi (dexi) Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura ( Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ) Sound Production: dugout Animation Producer: Takahiro Ogawa ( Zenshuu. ) Studio: MAPPA

Fujita serialized the music manga on Shueisha’s Shounen Jump+ app and website from February 2023 to January 2025, with the sixth and final volume released in March 2025 under the Jump Comics+ imprint.

The series originated from the "Million Tag" contest, an eight-part web competition launched by Shounen Jump+ in June 2021. Beat & Motion won the grand prize, securing its serialization and anime production.

Viz Media and Shueisha’s Manga Plus service licensed the series in English, with the sixth and final volume released in December 2025.

Synopsis Tatsuhiko Hirayama's love for drawing began at a young age, and his aspiration was to work in animation someday. But when the young boy is bullied for his art, Tatsuhiko swears to never draw in front of others ever again. Desperate to find something new to fill the void in his heart, he turns to music but eventually becomes jaded by his own mediocrity.

While Tatsuhiko is out drinking with his friends, his sob story earns the ire of a drunk woman, who intimidates the young man into reassessing his attitude toward life. He decides to give animation another chance and soon rediscovers his love for the medium, pushing himself to publish a short video. Tatsuhiko is stunned when the video goes viral, even more so when his favorite singer, Nico Kashiwagi, requests a collaboration on her next music video!

Excited to finally meet the artist he has admired for so long, the young man is shocked to discover that Nico is the same bar patron that gave him an earful, though she has no recollection of that drunken night. While initially hesitant of their new partnership, Tatsuhiko slowly learns that there is more to Nico's brutish passion than he realizes. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Official manga site: https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/4855956445112219921

title: MAPPA Produces 'Jimoto Saikou!' Anime Adaptation
content:
The 15th Anniversary Event of MAPPA announced an anime adaptation of usagi 's Jimoto Saikou! manga on Friday, revealing the main staff, theme song, teaser visual (pictured), and a promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere worldwide on Netflix.

Staff Director: Tokio Igarashi ( Ranma ½ (2024) episode director) Script: Ryou Takada ( Neko Neko Nihonshi 2nd Season ) Character Design: Rio ( Katsugeki/Touken Ranbu ) Art Director: Naoki Takada ( Zenshuu. background art) Color Design: Yukiko Kakita ( Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ) Director of Photography: Kaori Yoneda ( Chainsaw Man Movie: Reze-hen assistant director of photography) 3DCG Director: Yousei Sawai Editing: Tomoki Nagasaka ( Medalist ) Animation Producer: Takahiro Ogawa ( Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi ) Studio: MAPPA

Singer-songwriter aiko ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is performing the theme song "milk," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

usagi originally began serializing the comedy manga on X (formerly Twitter) in September 2020, later moving to an official series account in February 2021. Saizusha began publishing the series in 2021 and released the eighth e-book volume in August 2025.

Synopsis: This is a story about girls that have never left their hometown, and despite the misfortunes they face, continue to say "My hometown is the best!" (Source: MU)

title: Chainsaw Man: Assassins Arc Teaser Trailer Revealed, New Game & Opening Animation by MAPPA
content:
Chainsaw Man: International Assassins Arc revealed a new teaser trailer, along with a new smartphone game and opening animation by MAPPA. The anime was previously announced in December during the anime’s Jump Festa 2026 stage. You can watch the new trailer below.

The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation. The studio previously featured Reze in a special anniversary visual project , alongside Mikasa from Attack on Titan and Nobara Kugisaki from JUJUTSU KAISEN . A new smartphone game was also announced, showing the opening animation by MAPPA:

MAPPA announced its 15th anniversary project earlier this month, with the plan to share new information on its upcoming projects. Founded in 2011, the studio has been in charge of animating numerous hit titles including Chainsaw Man , Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Hell’s Paradise , Yuri on Ice , and Vinland Saga .

The presentation included new information related to Chainsaw Man and Dorohedoro , as well as for numerous others. The production of Dorohedoro Season 3 was previously confirmed. JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , titled the Culling Game Arc Part 2, is also in production.

The event also included segments dedicated to Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Oblivion Battery , and Ranma 1/2 , with each one also having “new information” teased.

Tatsuki Fujimoto first started the Chainsaw Man manga in 2018, and part 1 ended in 2020 with a total of 97 chapters and 11 volumes. Part 2 began in July 2022, running for 135 chapters until its ending on March 25 . Viz Media licensed the manga in English. The first anime season premiered last fall, and it ran for a total of 12 episodes. MAPPA CEO Manabu Otsuka said that the Chainsaw Man anime was a complete financial success . Kenshi Yonezu performed the opening theme song “KICK BACK,” while each episode had a different ending theme song performed by a different artist. Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc got its digital release earlier this month following its theatrical debut. The film premiered in theaters 2025, winning the title of the Anime Movie of the Year at our 6th yearly awards .

Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, and they describe the story: Denji is a teenage boy living with a Chainsaw Devil named Pochita. Due to the debt his father left behind, he has been living a rock-bottom life while repaying his debt by harvesting devil corpses with Pochita. One day, Denji is betrayed and killed. As his consciousness fades, he makes a contract with Pochita and gets revived as “Chainsaw Man”–a man with a devil’s heart.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Ranma 1/2 Anime's Season 3 Previewed in 2nd Trailer
content:
The anime studio MAPPA presented a second trailer for the third season in the new anime based on Rumiko Takahashi 's Ranma 1/2 manga on Friday.

Kōnosuke Uda is again directing the anime at MAPPA . The third season will have mainly returning cast and staff members. Returning chief animation directors Yoshiko Saitō and Kōsuke Kawamura will be joined by Riko Kaneda (new anime's first season animation director) and Haruki Miura ( Ensemble Stars! , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean ). Masahiro Kurio also returns as main animator with the addition of Atsuko Ishida ( Ranma ½ (TV 1/1989) key animator) and Yoshihiro Takeda ( The Devil Is a Part-Timer! seasons 2 & 3).

The third season will air on the NTV channel in October, and it will exclusively stream on Netflix .

The anime's first season premiered nationwide in Japan in October 2024. The anime exclusively streamed on Netflix after its broadcast.

Kōnosuke Uda ( One Piece: Dead End film, DAYS ) directed the first season at MAPPA . Kimiko Ueno ( Delicious in Dungeon , Astro Note ) was in charge of series scripts, and Hiromi Taniguchi ( Kurage no Shokudō ) designed the characters.

The second season premiered on October 4 on NTV . The series streamed on Netflix after the television broadcast. Most of the staff from the first season returned for the second season. However, Kōsuke Kawamura joined the staff as one of the chief animation directors, and Ryūta Hayashi joined Chihiro Ōkawa to direct the art.
author: ANN

title: 'Fall in Love, You False Angels' Anime's Teaser Announces Staff at MAPPA
content:
The anime studio MAPPA announced during its live-streamed "15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" event on Friday that it is producing the 2027 television anime of Coco Uzuki 's Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) manga. A teaser promotional video announced the staff:

[The video is now unavailable as private on YouTube as of 8:20 a.m. EDT.]

The main staff members are:

• Director: Yasutomo Okamoto

• Character Design: Mariko Oka

• Series Script Supervisor: Yōhei Yamazaki

• Art Director: Takumi Hashimoto

• Color Key Artist: Kana Tanabe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Shunsuke Taniguchi

• Editing: Ayumu Takahashi

• Animation Producer: Yuriko Waki

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

All sugar, no spice, and everything nice… that's the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and “heartthrob angel” class president Otogi Katsura gives to those around her. In reality, Otogi is brash, assertive, and has no problem calling out a jerk when she sees one—the complete opposite of her soft spoken vice presidential counterpart, the equally beautiful and seemingly perfect Toki Ninomae. One day, when a group of boys try to hit on her at the train station, Otogi doesn't hold back and gives them a piece of her mind—and, to her surprise, Toki enjoys seeing this side of her. Not only that, it turns out the seemingly polite, put-together vice president has a hidden side of his own… and Otogi now finds him more attractive than ever! Now “partners-in-crime,” Otogi and Toki agree to keep their hidden sides a secret from the rest of their classmates—but could this shared, dark secret also bring them closer together…?!

Uzuki debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Dessert magazine in April 2023. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on June 12.

The manga has won the Kodansha Manga Awards in 2025, was nominated for the Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2025, and ranked on top 20 on the list of manga for female readers for Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in multiple years.
author: ANN

title: MAPPA Produces Beat & Motion Anime Debuting on Netflix in 2027
content:
The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed that MAPPA is producing the anime adaptation of Naoki Fujita 's Beat & Motion manga that will debut on Netflix in 2027. The announcement revealed a teaser visual, first trailer, full staff, and two main cast members.

The anime's staff includes:

• Director: Yuki Komada

• Series Composition, Scripts: Misaki Morie

• Character Designer, Chief Animation Director: Kazunori Aoki

• Chief Animation Director: Mina Ōsawa

• Assistant Director: Izumi Takizawa

• Production Chief: Megumi Soga

• Art Director: Haruna Sakamoto

• Color Design: Minori Nishida

• CGI Producer: Yusuke Tannawa

• 3DCG Director: Sayaka Tsushima, Tamaki Ishida

• Director of Photography: Madoka Yagi

• Editing: Masato Yoshitake

• Script Supervisor: Concept Design: Tomoyuki Itamura

• Costume Stylist: Mari Ishibashi (dexi)

• Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura

• Sound Production: dugout

• Animation Producer: Takahiro Ogawa

• Production: MAPPA

The anime will star Shūichirō Umeda as Tatsuhiko and Aya Gomazuru as Nico.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are both releasing the manga in English. Viz Media describes the first volume:

After that fateful night, Tatsuhiko posts a new animation on social media and soon finds that it's gone viral! His favorite musician, Nico, reaches out and asks him to collaborate on a music video for one of her songs. At their first meeting, Tatsuhiko is shocked to discover that he recognizes Nico from the night that changed everything…

The manga was the MILLION TAG reality show winner in August 2021. Aside from getting his manga serialized on Shonen Jump+ , Fujita also won 5 million yen (about US$45,000 at that time), a compiled book volume of his manga, and an anime adaptation that will stream globally and exclusively on Netflix .

The manga launched on the Shonen Jump+ website and app in February 2023. The manga's sixth and final shipped in March 2025.

title: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, July 6 Premiere
content:
The previously announced Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her (Tenbin) anime revealed a new visual and trailer along with a July 6 premiere d

The anime stars:

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Haruki Nikado

• Shunichi Toki as Hayato Kirishima

• Miharu Hanai as Himeko Kirishima

• Natsumi Haruse as Minamo Mitake

• Fuka Izumi as Saki Murao

Chuan Feng Xu is directing the anime, and Deko Akao is in charge of the script. Nukuru Kurahashi is designing the characters based on Siso’s original illustrations. Ryosuke Nakanishi, Naoki Tani, and Yuri Morita (Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out!) are composing the music.

The story first appeared as a web novel on Shosetsuka ni Naro in June 2020. Kadokawa released a revised edition with illustrations under its Sneaker Bunko label in February 2021. Kina Oyama also illustrates a manga adaptation.

The story follows Hayato Kirishima, who moves from the countryside to a city high school. There he unexpectedly reunites with Haruki, a childhood friend he hadn’t seen in seven years. Back when they were kids, Hayato assumed Haruki was a boy, but now Haruki has grown into a beautiful girl. Their reunion sets the stage for a romantic comedy of misunderstandings, nostalgia, and new feelings.

title: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 New Trailer Revealed Ahead of October Return
content:
Ranma 1/2 Season 3 revealed a new teaser trailer, with the anime set to premiere on Netflix in October 2026. Studio MAPPA is back to handle the animation, with Konosuke Uda returning to direct alongside most of the core staff. Season 2 aired in the Fall 2025 season .

The announcement was made during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation. The studio previously featured Nobara in a special anniversary visual project , alongside Reze from Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc and Mikasa from Attack on Titan . You can watch the trailer below.

MAPPA announced its 15th anniversary project earlier this month, with the plan to share new information on its upcoming projects. Founded in 2011, the studio has been in charge of animating numerous hit titles including Chainsaw Man , Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Hell’s Paradise , Yuri on Ice , and Vinland Saga .

The presentation also included new information related to Chainsaw Man and Dorohedoro , as well as for numerous others. The production of Chainsaw Man International Assassins Arc and Dorohedoro Season 3 was previously confirmed. JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , titled the Culling Game Arc Part 2, is also in production.

The event also included segments dedicated to Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Oblivion Battery , and Ranma 1/2 , with each one also having “new information” teased.

Kimiko Ueno is back in charge of series composition. The character design is handled by Hiromi Taniguchi, who also serves as chief animation director alongside Yoshiko Saito, Kosuke Kawamura, Riko Kaneda, and Haruki Miura. Kaoru Wada returns to compose the music, while Chihiro Okawa leads the art direction.

The voice cast is all returning and includes:

• Kappei Yamaguchi as Ranma Saotome

• Megumi Hayashibara as Ranma

• Noriko Hidaka as Akane Tendo

• Minami Takayama as Nabiki Tendo

• Kikuko Inoue as Kasumi Tendo

• Akio Otsuka as Soun Tendo

• Cho as Genma Saotome

• Koichi Yamadera as Ryoga Hibiki

• Rei Sakuma as Shampoo

• Toshihiko Seki as Mousse

• Kaori Nazuka as Ukyo Kuonji

• Tomokazu Sugita as Tatewaki Kuno

• Ayane Sakura as Kodachi Kuno

• Kazuhiko Inoue as Happosai

• Ako Mayama as Cologne

• Toshiyuki Morikawa as Tofu Ono

• Mamoru Miyano as Mikado Sanzenin

• Aoi Yuki as Azusa Shiratori

• Akira Ishida as Hikaru Gosunkugi

• Tomokazu Seki as Ichiro

title: Dorohedoro Season 3 Special Teaser Trailer Revealed
content:
Dorohedoro Season 3 anime revealed a special teaser trailer during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary presentation event. The anime was previously announced right after the Season 2 finale. The studio previously featured Nobara in a special anniversary visual project , alongside Reze from Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc and Mikasa from Attack on Titan . You can watch the new teaser trailer below.

MAPPA announced its 15th anniversary project earlier this month, with the plan to share new information on its upcoming projects. Founded in 2011, the studio has been in charge of animating numerous hit titles including Chainsaw Man , Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Hell’s Paradise , Yuri on Ice , and Vinland Saga .

The presentation also included new information related to Chainsaw Man , as well as for numerous others. The production of Chainsaw Man International Assassins Arc was previously confirmed. JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , titled the Culling Game Arc Part 2, is also in production.

The event also included segments dedicated to Jujutsu Kaisen , Attack on Titan Final Season , Oblivion Battery , and Ranma 1/2 , with each one also having “new information” teased.

Studio MAPPA was again in charge of the animation production, with Yuichiro Hayashi as the director. The sequel was announced in January 2024, while it premiered on April 1. Crunchyroll, Netflix, Animation Digital Network, and Ani-One Asia ULTRA are all streaming the anime.

The first season of Dorohedoro premiered in January 2020 and ran for 12 episodes. Six short OVA episodes were bundled with the series’ second Blu-ray release on June 17, 2020, while they arrived on Netflix on October 15, 2020 as a single episode labeled Episode 13.

The staff for Season 2 included:

• Director: Yuichiro Hayashi

• Series Composition: Hiroshi Seko

• Character Designer: Tomohiro Kishi

• Worldbuilding Concept Designer: Shinji Kimura

• Sound Director: Akiko Fujita

• Music Production: (K)NoW_NAME

• Animation Production: MAPPA

The full voice cast for the anime includes:

• Wataru Takagi as Caiman

• Reina Kondo as Nikaido

• Kenyu Horiuchi as En

• Yoshimasa Hosoya as Shin

• Yu Kobayashi as Noi

• Kengo Takanashi as Fujita

• Miyu Tomita as Ebisu

• Hisao Egawa as Vaux

• Mitsuhiro Ichiki as Kasukabe

• Mayu Udono as Kikurage

• Soungdok as Risu

• Tetsu Inada as Tanba

• Shin-ichiro Miki as Turkey

• Hozumi Goda as Asu

• Anri Katsu as Chota

• Ryohei Kimura as Jonson

• Yuki Kaji as Thirteen

• Subaru Kimura as Aikawa

• Koki Uchiyama as Dokuga

• Daiki Hamano as Tetsujo

• Yuichi Koshimura as Saji

• Katsuhito Nomura as Ton

• Atsushi Imaruoka as Ushishimada

• Sara Matsumoto as Natsuki

Q Hayashida wrote and illustrated the Dorohedoro manga. It was serialized in Shogakukan’s manga magazines Monthly Ikki from November 2000 to September 2014, Hibana from March 2015 to August 2017, and Monthly Shonen Sunday from November 2017 to September 2018. It was compiled into a total of 23 volumes. A new one-shot was released on April 11 to commemorate the second anime season. VIZ Media licensed it in English, describing the story as: In a city so dismal it’s known only as “the Hole,” a clan of Sorcerers have been plucking people off the streets to use as guinea pigs for atrocious “experiments” in the black arts. In a dark alley, Nikaido found Caiman, a man with a reptile head and a bad case of amnesia. To undo the spell, they’re hunting and killing the Sorcerers in the Hole, hoping that eventually they’ll kill the right one. But when En, the head Sorcerer, gets word of a lizard-man slaughtering his people, he sends a crew of “cleaners” into the Hole, igniting a war between two worlds.

title: 'Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo' Unveils Main Staff, Teaser Promo
content:
The 15th Anniversary Event of MAPPA unveiled the main staff, teaser visual (pictured) and promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki 's Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ( Fall in Love, You False Angels ) manga on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Staff Director: Yasutomo Okamoto ( Zenshuu. ) Series Composition: Youhei Yamazaki ( Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi 2 script) Character Design: Mariko Oka ( Momochi-san Chi no Ayakashi Ouji ) Art Director: Takumi Hashimoto ( Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online II ) Color Design: Kana Tanabe ( Lazarus ) Director of Photography: Shunsuke Taniguchi ( Chainsaw Man assistant director of photography) Editing: Ayumu Takahashi ( Gachiakuta ) Animation Producer: Yuriko Waki ( Zombieland Saga Movie: Yumeginga Paradise ) Studio: MAPPA

Uzuki began serializing the shoujo romance manga in April 2023 in Kodansha's magazine Dessert , and the seventh volume shipped on June 12. Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo has reached 2.25 million copies in circulation worldwide.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in March 2024 and released the fourth volume in December 2025. The fifth volume is scheduled for release on June 23.

Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ranked 18th in the 2024 Kono Manga ga Sugoi! Female readers division, climbing to fifth in 2025, and placed 15th in 2026. The series won the 49th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shoujo category in 2025 and was nominated for the 71st Shogakukan Manga Award.
